name: KTDC Golden Peak Resort Restaurant
signature_dish: Multi-cuisine Kerala and South Indian meals at the only tourist eatery on Ponmudi summit
why_it_matters: The restaurant of KTDC Golden Peak, the Kerala state tourism hill resort — and effectively the only place open to tourists for a proper meal on the Ponmudi summit, since private hotels are not permitted in this strategic-military hill area. It serves a multi-cuisine menu of Kerala, South Indian, North Indian and Continental dishes.
insider_tip: Lunch and dinner must be pre-ordered an hour or two ahead — the kitchen has limited offerings, so do not turn up expecting a quick meal. The buffet breakfast is the most elaborate option. Carry snacks for the hill drive; food choice up here is genuinely scarce.
signature_address: KTDC Golden Peak Resort, Ponmudi, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala 695551

name: Malabar Restaurant & Hotel Vithura
area: Vithura town, base of the Ponmudi ghat road
signature_dish: Kerala meals and Malabar dishes — the dependable food stop before the hill climb
why_it_matters: An everyday Kerala-and-Malabar restaurant in Vithura town, at the base of the 22-hairpin ghat road up to Ponmudi. With food genuinely scarce on the summit, Vithura is the practical place to eat a proper meal before or after the climb, and Malabar Restaurant is one of the established options there.
insider_tip: Eat here on the way up — do not count on finding a meal on the Ponmudi summit without a pre-order at the KTDC resort. Order the Kerala meals or fish curry. Cash and UPI.
signature_address: Malabar Restaurant & Hotel, Vithura, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala 695551

name: Bab Al Mandi Vithura
area: Vithura town, base of the Ponmudi ghat road
signature_dish: Arabic mandi — slow-cooked spiced rice with chicken or mutton
why_it_matters: An Arabic mandi-and-grill restaurant in Vithura at the foot of the Ponmudi road — rated around 4.2 on Justdial. It gives travellers a second, well-rated option in Vithura for a filling mandi or grill meal before tackling the hairpins or on the way back down.
insider_tip: Order the chicken or mutton mandi — that is what the place is built around. A casual walk-in spot; cash and UPI. Useful as a Vithura meal stop given how limited food is on the Ponmudi summit.
signature_address: Bab Al Mandi, Vithura, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala 695551
